doc.title: Earl Watkins interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 7, 2002

title: Closing remarks
summary: Rowe wraps up and proposes a Part Two; Watkins jokes about drifting.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing the interview: thanks, goodbyes and tape running out

blocks.x: Cool. Well Mr. Watkins, this has been fascinating. And we’re going to wrap up here. And we probably, next time I come to town we could do Part Two.
Oh well, I have a tendency to drift.
That’s okay, you’ve got a lot of great stuff here.
We could move things around a little bit.
Then we might get some good stuff.
Well thank you so much for your time.
